commands.command:
set -eu
EXPECTED=6e07b331162d1835477a8f06bffa838b269f5d85
BASE=f046509955527db3ad2aa39d0fb8e71bd381903e
[ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ] || { echo 'ABORT dirty worktree'; git status --short; exit 41; }
git fetch --prune origin
git switch main >/dev/null 2>&1
git merge --ff-only origin/main >/dev/null
ACTUAL=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo "REVISION|$ACTUAL"
[ "$ACTUAL" = "$EXPECTED" ] || { echo "ABORT expected=$EXPECTED actual=$ACTUAL"; exit 42; }
git diff --check "$BASE..HEAD"
grep -q 'performance work is paused' docs/PERFORMANCE_HANDOFF.md
grep -q 'feature and performance work is paused' docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md
grep -q 'ML remains shadow/research-only' docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md
[ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ] || { echo 'ABORT final worktree dirty'; git status --short; exit 43; }
echo 'CLOSEOUT_VERIFY_DONE|bloomml'
